items.title: AT&T Reports Strong First-Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.snippet: AT&T reiterated all full-year 2026 and multi-year financial guidance; the release also highlighted Advanced Connectivity service revenue of $22.9 billion, up 3.6% year over year.

items.title: AT&T Inc. Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2026
items.snippet: AT&T’s filing discusses factors that may materially affect future earnings and references risks discussed in its most recent Form 10-K.
